note: Skill Packs — gem-only gacha pulls granting pack-exclusive skills (data/skills.json entries with "source": "skill_pack"). One purchase = 3 pulls from the shared 55-skill pool below. Pulling a skill the player already owns is wasted (skipped, not replaced) — see plugins/skillpack.js. Odds are per-pull percentages across the 5 tiers and must sum to 100.

packs.name: Common Cache
packs.description: The entry-level pull. Mostly common/uncommon skills with a modest shot at something rarer.

packs.name: Rare Vault
packs.description: Weighted toward the middle tiers — better odds at rare and epic, a real shot at mythic.

packs.name: Mythic Reliquary
packs.description: The premium pull. Highest mythic odds of any pack — built for players chasing the top tier.
